text:
Situation: Dabigatran etexilate mesylate is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 127 capsules of 110 mg (13.3 days) and 289 capsules of 75 mg (32 days). Corvale General holds 228 capsules of 110 mg (21.7 days) and 263 capsules of 75 mg (26.4 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 35 capsules of 75 mg (20.3 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows dabigatran etexilate mesylate is not listed as of 2026-10-21. Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG (FEI 3002806556) has import alert 66-66 dated 2009-09-30, a prior OAI inspection ending 2012-11-12, and a VAI inspection ending 2025-05-15. Bidachem S.p.A. (FEI 3002806598) shows VAI inspections ending 2018-11-23 and 2024-05-17. Sixarp, LLC (FEI 1000115322) shows a VAI inspection ending 2010-05-28 and a NAI inspection dated 2025-03-06.

Our position: Current inventory across three sites provides 13 to 32 days of supply depending on presentation and location. No FDA shortage listing exists. Alternate manufacturers are not on FDA's shortage list but their labels name no identifiable plant.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. as first ranked alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as second ranked alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate Apotex Corp. as third ranked alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate Ascend Laboratories, LLC as fourth ranked alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer to evaluate Aurobindo Pharma Limited as fifth ranked alternate source; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions remain with treating clinicians and the committee.
